_about: Fault-matching check (Phase 2a step A): does the graph pick the right fault from the operator's words? Sets: 'alarm' = alarm-style wording (the original WM-101 graph value cases), 'everyday' = how people actually talk, 'user' = written by the project owner, 'fresh' = the exam, written AFTER the matcher was tuned (add them later, never tune on them). 'expect' is the fault label in the graph. Fresh set FL-f1..f7 written by the user 2026-09-30, after tuning; never tune on them.
